base_paddings.description: Optional int32 Tensor of shape [N, 2]. Specifies the minimum amount of padding to use. All elements must be >= 0. If not specified, defaults to 0.

output.description: (paddings, crops), where: `paddings` and `crops` are int32 Tensors of rank 2 and shape [N, 2] satisfying: paddings[i, 0] = base_paddings[i, 0]. 0 <= paddings[i, 1] - base_paddings[i, 1] < block_shape[i] (input_shape[i] + paddings[i, 0] + paddings[i, 1]) % block_shape[i] == 0 crops[i, 0] = 0 crops[i, 1] = paddings[i, 1] - base_paddings[i, 1] ValueError if called with incompatible shapes.
